## Exact bounded ledger bootstrap

The original ledger remains exactly835286 bytes, SHA256
`09f5b0c0b824b8fac2b8fcaa21bc022172955d456bf622bc1bbe3c1aee3a666c`, Git blob
`c7eb5b5acd5436c2f1e10958c4503582c66d4c1f`.

Deterministic gzip level9, empty filename and mtime0 produce54309 bytes. Canonical
base64 produces72412 bytes, split into32768,32768 and6876-byte text parts. No part
exceeds32KiB. `ledger-encoding.json` fixes every identity, ordered path, size and
hash. The unchanged290KB inventory is not compressed or rewritten.

Workflow first checks its literal bootstrap, gate and control-manifest SHA pins.
Bootstrap then verifies every tracked control hash and exact HEAD/parent/diff,
checks the manifest remains unmodified in the checkout, and requires that the
raw ledger is absent from tracked files. Only then does it read the encoded parts.
Gate repeats the same bootstrap before source/runtime/budget admission, so direct
runner invocation cannot omit this preflight.

Parts and metadata reject missing/duplicate/extra entries, path traversal,
symlinks, hard links, oversized input, invalid/corrupt base64 and unknown fields.
Reads use non-following directory/file descriptors and bounded lengths. A single
bounded zlib gzip stream may produce no more than835286 bytes; truncated streams,
extra gzip members, trailing data and size bombs fail. Original size, SHA256 and
Git blob are all rechecked before output.

The one fixed output is `.github/gui-batch005/prior-ledger.json`. It is installed
atomically with exclusive linking from an owned temporary file; an existing file
is never overwritten. A valid existing output is rechecked without changing its
inode/mtime. An abnormal, corrupt, linked or non-regular existing output fails.
Tracked files and this single derived output have separate whitelists. The derived
ledger must never appear in `control-hashes.json`, `STAGING-PATHS.txt` or HEAD diff.

`bootstrap-selftest.py` proves byte-for-byte reconstruction, deterministic encoding,
50 rejection controls and ordering before restoration, then the existing process
and budget selftests run unchanged. These are local/lightweight checks, not a real
CI activation. Previous drafts, runner, guard, coverage, selection, source and all
cumulative budget values remain unchanged. **Do not stage the restored raw ledger.**
